items.title: 10年期美債殖利率都攻上5%了！選擇權市場為何如此淡定？
items.title_en: 10‑Year US Treasury Yields Have Hit 5%—Why Is the Options Market So Calm?
paras: 美國10年期公債殖利率今年一路攀升至5%，但利率選擇權市場並未反映即將出現劇烈波動，顯示投資人相信美國經濟足以承受較高借貸成本，並逐漸接受利率將在更長時間內維持高檔。
目前三個月期10年期利率選擇權反映的年化波動幅度約為79.5個基點，遠低於2023年10月殖利率逼近5%時的約134個基點。當時及過去兩次短暫觸及5%的期間，市場與經濟不確定性迅速升高，殖利率也很快回落；如今交易員的態度明顯更加冷靜。
美國10年期公債殖利率上周突破5%，為三年來首見，並在聯準會(Fed)周三公布利率決策後再次回到這一水準，但利率波動仍受到控制。分析師認為，這反映美債價格自Fed 7月會議以來有秩序地下跌，尚未出現失控跡象。

殖利率緩步攀升 市場未見恐慌性拋售

Truist Wealth固定收益董事總經理休吉(Chip Hughey)表示，殖利率上升其實是歷時七個月的緩慢過程，市場不只在意殖利率達到多高，也在意上升速度及背後原因。只有當殖利率突然加速攀升時，投資人才容易感到不安。
美國10年期公債殖利率過去25年幾乎未能持續站穩5%，僅在2006年及2007年短暫突破。上一次逼近這一水準是在2023年底，當時美國財政部擴大長天期公債標售規模，引發市場對供給增加的擔憂。
儘管美國債務及財政赤字問題持續受到關注，巴克萊衍生性商品策略主管納希卡爾(Amrut Nashikkar)認為，這波美債賣壓主要並非源於需求不足，而是美國經濟展望更加強勁。市場年初原本預期Fed將降息，如今已轉為押注多次升息及更高的長期政策利率。
隨著投資人逐漸接受Fed將維持「更高更久」政策，利率方向的不確定性反而下降，殖利率即使處於較高水準，也可能在相對狹窄的區間內波動。

企業獲利強勁 高利率暫未壓垮信用市場

納希卡爾指出，近期利率上升主要反映短期政策利率預期提高，用來補償投資人承擔長期持債風險的「期限溢價」升幅相對有限。這顯示市場並未廣泛擔憂財政失控，而是認為美國經濟可承受比原先預期更高的利率。
不過，短期利率選擇權需求仍然旺盛，顯示市場無法確定Fed未來幾次會議的決策。由於Fed不提供明確前瞻指引，投資人必須逐次會議重新評估政策方向，短端利率波動較高將成為市場的結構性特徵。
Crossmark Global Investments首席市場策略師費南德茲(Victoria Fernandez)表示，美國企業獲利強勁，也是壓低長期利率波動的重要原因。未來兩季企業獲利預估將成長25%至26%，利潤率則達17%，創約30年最高。
與此同時，信用利差仍大致維持低檔，投資等級科技公司債利差上周甚至進一步收窄，加上勞動市場未出現大規模裁員，讓投資人目前仍願意消化較高殖利率。但費南德茲也提醒，這種承受力的前提是高利率不會延續多年。
paras_en: US 10‑year Treasury yields have risen to 5% this year, yet the interest‑rate options market has not reflected the imminent volatility, indicating investors believe the US economy can bear higher borrowing costs and are gradually accepting that rates will stay elevated for a longer period.

Currently, the three‑month 10‑year rate option implies an annualised volatility of about 79.5 basis points, far below the roughly 134 basis points seen in October 2023 when yields approached 5%. At that time, and during the two brief episodes when yields touched 5% previously, market and economic uncertainty spiked and yields quickly retreated; today traders are noticeably more composed.

US 10‑year Treasury yields broke the 5% mark last week – the first time in three years – and returned to that level after the Fed’s Wednesday rate decision, though rate volatility remains contained. Analysts say this shows Treasury prices have been falling in an orderly way since the Fed’s July meeting, with no signs of a loss of control.

Yield gains have been a gradual, seven‑month process, says Chip Hughey, managing director of fixed‑income at Truist Wealth. The market cares not only about how high yields get, but also about the speed of the rise and its underlying reasons. Only a sudden acceleration in yields tends to unsettle investors.

In the past 25 years the US 10‑year Treasury has rarely held steady at 5%, briefly breaking through only in 2006 and 2007. The last time it came close was at the end of 2023, when the Treasury expanded its long‑term issuance, sparking concerns about increased supply.

Even though US debt and fiscal‑deficit issues remain in focus, Amrut Nashikkar, head of derivatives strategy at Barclays, believes the current selling pressure on Treasuries stems less from weak demand and more from a stronger outlook for the US economy. Early‑year expectations of Fed rate cuts have shifted to bets on multiple hikes and higher long‑term policy rates.

As investors increasingly accept that the Fed will keep a “higher‑for‑longer” stance, uncertainty about rate direction has actually fallen, meaning yields—even at elevated levels—may fluctuate within a relatively narrow band.

Nashikkar notes that the recent rise in rates mainly reflects higher short‑term policy‑rate expectations, with only a modest increase in the term premium that compensates investors for bearing long‑term bond risk. This suggests the market is not broadly worried about fiscal loss of control, but rather sees the US economy capable of handling higher rates than previously thought.

Nevertheless, demand for short‑term rate options remains strong, showing the market cannot pin down how many more Fed meetings will result in moves. Because the Fed provides no clear forward guidance, investors must reassess policy at each meeting, making higher short‑end rate volatility a structural feature.

Victoria Fernandez, chief market strategist at Crossmark Global Investments, says robust corporate earnings are a key factor keeping long‑term rate volatility low. She projects earnings growth of 25%‑26% over the next two quarters, with profit margins around 17%, the highest in roughly 30 years.

At the same time, credit spreads remain broadly low; investment‑grade tech bond spreads even narrowed further last week, and the labor market has avoided large‑scale layoffs, allowing investors to tolerate higher yields for now. Fernandez cautions, however, that this tolerance hinges on high rates not persisting for many years.

items.title: AI晶片還不夠賣！黃仁勳估輝達明年銷量直接翻倍
items.title_en: AI Chips Still Not Enough to Sell! Jensen Huang Expects Nvidia's Sales to Double Next Year
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳周四(17日)表示，隨著人工智慧(AI)加速導入不同產業，公司預期未來一年晶片銷量將成長一倍，延續他對AI需求前景的樂觀看法。消息帶動輝達股價盤中一度上漲2.8%，扭轉上周回落走勢，今年來累計漲幅擴大至約17%。
黃仁勳在蘇格蘭出席英國國王查爾斯三世召集的活動時向媒體表示，AI可為各行各業帶來龐大效益，應用範圍持續擴張。輝達目前是全球AI加速器的主要供應商，相關晶片廣泛用於訓練及運行AI模型。
輝達上月預估，下個會計年度營收將成長70%。公司當時表示，若能取得足夠供應以滿足快速增加的需求，營收甚至可能翻倍。黃仁勳最新說法顯示，輝達仍認為市場需求遠高於目前可供應的產能，晶片出貨成長關鍵將取決於供應鏈能否及時擴充。
不過，AI技術快速發展也引發安全疑慮。近期部分產業領袖因擔心AI可能帶來潛在危險，開始討論是否應放慢開發速度。黃仁勳表示，企業必須承擔責任，在推出AI軟體與服務前，確認產品具備足夠安全性。
黃仁勳一方面支持企業強化AI安全把關，另一方面仍看好AI向更多產業普及後帶來的晶片需求。若輝達供應能力順利跟上，公司明年的成長幅度可能超越原先預估。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang said on Thursday (the 17th) that as artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly adopted across industries, the company expects chip sales to grow by 100% over the next year, continuing his upbeat outlook on AI demand. The news lifted Nvidia’s stock by as much as 2.8% intraday, reversing last week’s decline and bringing the year‑to‑date gain to roughly 17%.

Speaking to the media at an event in Scotland convened by King Charles III, Huang said AI can deliver massive benefits to every sector and its range of applications keeps expanding. Nvidia is currently the world’s leading supplier of AI accelerators, with its chips widely used to train and run AI models.

Last month Nvidia projected a 70% revenue increase for the next fiscal year. The company added that if it can secure enough supply to meet the rapidly rising demand, revenue could even double. Huang’s latest comments show Nvidia still believes market demand far exceeds the capacity it can currently deliver, and that the key to shipment growth will be whether the supply chain can expand quickly enough.

However, the rapid development of AI also raises safety concerns. Recently, some industry leaders, worried about the potential dangers of AI, have begun discussing whether development should be slowed. Huang said companies must take responsibility and ensure their AI software and services are sufficiently safe before they are released.

While Huang supports stronger AI safety safeguards, he remains confident that broader AI adoption across more industries will drive chip demand. If Nvidia’s supply capability keeps pace, the company’s growth next year could exceed its original forecasts.

items.title: 美光今年狂飆226%！分析師：下一波漲勢靠「估值重估」
items.title_en: Micron Soars 226% This Year! Analyst: Next Wave Rides “Valuation Re‑rating”
paras: 美光科技(MU-US)股價今年已大漲226%，但未來推動股價動能的因素，可能與迄今帶動該股躋身人工智慧(AI)贏家行列的因素不同。
驚人的獲利成長一直是美光股價飆升的主要推手。事實上，美光股票一直以「便宜」著稱，目前股價相對於下一個日曆年預估獲利的本益比僅5.77倍，是標普500指數成分股中第五低的估值倍數。
不過，TD Cowen分析師Krish Sankar指出，有理由相信美光股價很快可能獲得更高的本益比。他認為，這種「估值重估」的力量可能推動股價進一步上漲，而此時投資人可能開始擔心，美光的利潤率——也就是衡量獲利能力的指標——進一步擴張的空間已不大。

「估值重估」成新動能

Sankar給予美光1600美元目標價，這是以2027年預估獲利9倍本益比計算，明顯高於目前5.77倍的本益比。該目標價較美光目前每股約934美元的股價高出約70%。
Sankar表示，美光目前大約已走完典型18個月利潤率擴張周期的80%，代表未來一段時間的獲利預估，可能不會像近期一樣大幅上修。
在記憶體晶片價格維持高檔的情況下，美光最近公布的單季EPS大增1215%，凸顯獲利改善的幅度驚人，相信投資人已經很熟悉這種情況。
Sankar坦承，美光可能出現獲利從高峰回落、但「股價持續緩步走高」的情境，因為他認為，投資人將相信記憶體產業周期「比利潤率走勢所暗示的更具持久性」。

這次周期與過去不同

用於儲存AI內容的DRAM需求持續蓬勃成長，而且和過去的記憶體周期不同，未來不會受到消費電子需求的限制。Sankar指出，2019年與2022年的景氣低谷，是「供給超前需求」的局面，但這次情況有所不同，持續不斷的需求可能支撐美光股價。
Sankar並將美光與鋼鐵生產商Nucor(NUE-US)相提並論。Nucor自2022年以來估值倍數大幅擴張，推動因素並非獲利，而是當時「對產業周期持久性以及美國政策支持的信心增加」。
Sankar表示，美光是「美國唯一一家大型DRAM製造商」，而截至2030年底，美光在美國的晶圓產能可能約占全球業界總產能的一半，這應該有助於投資人建立對未來需求的信心。
美光預定9月30日公布財報，Sankar認為，股東報酬將是財報電話會議上最重要的議題之一。他預期美光可能核准規模約200億至300億美元的庫藏股計畫，不過可能不會在12月前啟動回購。
paras_en: Micron Technology (MU‑US) shares have surged 226% so far this year, but the factors that will drive future price momentum may differ from those that have so far propelled the stock into the AI winners’ club.

Stunning earnings growth has been the main engine behind Micron’s stock rally. In fact, Micron has long been regarded as “cheap”; its current price‑to‑earnings ratio based on next calendar‑year earnings estimates is only 5.77×, the fifth‑lowest valuation multiple among S&P 500 constituents.

However, TD Cowen analyst Krish Sankar notes there is reason to believe Micron’s share price could soon command a higher P/E. He thinks a “valuation re‑rating” could push the stock higher, at which point investors may start worrying that there is little room left for further expansion of Micron’s profit margins—the metric that gauges profitability.

“Valuation re‑rating” becomes a new driver. Sankar assigns Micron a $1,600 target price, based on a 2027 earnings multiple of 9×, clearly above the current 5.77×. That target is about 70% higher than Micron’s present share price of roughly $934.

Sankar says Micron has already completed about 80% of a typical 18‑month profit‑margin expansion cycle, meaning earnings forecasts in the near term may not be revised upward as dramatically as they have been recently.
With memory‑chip prices staying high, Micron just reported a quarterly EPS jump of 1,215%, underscoring a spectacular improvement in profitability that investors are now very familiar with.

Sankar admits Micron could see earnings fall from a peak while the “stock continues to creep higher,” because he believes investors will view the memory‑industry cycle as more durable than the profit‑margin trend suggests.

This cycle is different from past ones. DRAM demand for storing AI content continues to grow robustly and, unlike previous memory cycles, will not be constrained by consumer‑electronics demand. Sankar points out that the 2019‑2022 downturns were characterized by “supply outpacing demand,” whereas this time persistent demand could support Micron’s stock.

Sankar likens Micron to steelmaker Nucor (NUE‑US). Nucor’s valuation multiples have expanded sharply since 2022, driven not by earnings but by growing confidence in the durability of the industry cycle and U.S. policy support.

Sankar notes Micron is “the only large‑scale DRAM manufacturer in the United States,” and by the end of 2030 its U.S. wafer capacity could represent roughly half of global industry capacity, which should help investors feel confident about future demand.

Micron is scheduled to release its earnings on September 30. Sankar believes shareholder returns will be one of the top topics in the earnings call. He expects Micron may approve a share‑repurchase program of about $20 billion to $30 billion, though buybacks likely won’t start before December.

items.title: 油價、利率與公債殖利率齊升！市場最怕的停滯性通膨正在成形
items.title_en: Oil Prices, Interest Rates and Government Bond Yields All Rise! The Most Feared Stagnant Inflation Is Taking Shape
paras: 中東戰事帶動能源價格、全球利率及公債殖利率同步攀升，正將全球經濟與金融市場推向高通膨、低成長並存的「停滯性通膨」風險。美股目前仍徘徊歷史高點附近，人工智慧(AI)投資熱潮也支撐經濟與企業獲利，但愈來愈多數據顯示，表面韌性正在出現裂痕。
法律與通用投資管理公司(LGIM)宏觀策略主管傑佛瑞(Chris Jeffery)表示，能源與借貸成本上升迄今主要仍是「商品與利率的故事」，尚未全面演變成股市及信用市場危機，但市場可能正逐漸逼近衝擊企業股票與債券的臨界點。

油價重返百美元 通膨壓力捲土重來

隨著中東攻擊行動升級並威脅更多供應路線，原油期貨重新站上每桶100美元，較戰爭爆發前大漲50%，衍生性商品市場也顯示，交易員不預期油價短期內明顯回落。
目前市場押注最集中的選擇權是布蘭特原油在12月底處於每桶100美元，但押注油價跌至60美元的賣權緊追在後，凸顯市場對能源前景存在巨大分歧。除了原油，柴油價格逼近歷史新高，航空燃油較2月伊朗戰爭爆發前翻倍，歐洲天然氣則升至2022年以來最高。
預測市場Polymarket的交易顯示，投資人認為荷姆茲海峽能在12月前恢復通行的機率僅18%，意味能源供應風險可能長期化。
能源漲價已開始反映在消費者物價。美國8月整體通膨率維持在3.4%，其中汽油價格上漲3.9%；歐元區通膨率由7月的2.9%升至8月的3.3%，明顯高於歐洲央行(ECB)的2%目標；英國8月通膨率也升至五個月高點3.1%。
歐洲央行已將明年平均通膨預測上調至2.5%，並預估2027年核心通膨率為2.6%。交換市場的定價更為悲觀，反映歐元區明年通膨率可能達3.5%，五年後仍約為2.4%。

降息預期全面逆轉 各國央行重回升息軌道

中東戰爭已徹底改變全球利率前景。市場與經濟學家原先預期主要央行將維持利率不變或轉向降息，如今交易員押注歐洲央行未來一年將累計升息接近4碼，聯準會(Fed)周三升息1碼後，至少還會再升息兩次。
英國央行周四雖維持利率在3.75%不變，卻預估英國通膨率可能在2027年初突破4%，相當於官方目標的兩倍，遠高於先前預測的2026年底3.2%高峰。日本央行則被預期周五將升息至31年來最高水準，市場也已反映後續進一步升息的可能性。
公債市場的賣壓同步推高各類借貸成本。美國30年期房貸平均利率已突破6.7%，創2025年6月以來最高。由於政府公債殖利率通常是企業貸款、房貸及其他融資成本的定價基準，債市波動正逐步傳導至實體經濟。
目前美國與歐洲採購經理人指數(PMI)仍顯示民間部門穩健擴張，英國7月經濟成長與美國8月零售銷售也優於預期。根據LSEG I/B/E/S資料，標普500指數成分股第二季獲利預估年增53%，成為股市維持高檔的重要支柱。

家庭支出遭到夾擊 消費類股率先示警

市場真正的考驗，在於經濟能否同時承受高能源價格與高借貸成本，尤其投資人已開始質疑數千億美元AI支出的持續性。
消費者正站在這場風暴的第一線。汽油價格快速攀升，家庭能源帳單可能在冬季跟進上漲。歐洲目前天然氣庫存更降至同期15年最低，加上房貸及其他借貸利率走高、薪資成長追不上物價，家庭可支配所得面臨進一步壓縮。
消費類股已率先反映經濟放緩風險。美國非必需消費類股今年累計下跌近6%，成為華爾街表現最差的類股，同期標普500指數仍上漲10%。歐洲情況更為明顯，非必需消費類股今年重挫17%，表現僅優於奢侈品類股，遠遜於道瓊歐洲600指數的7.5%漲幅。
隨著利率與生活成本同步上升，財務吃緊的家庭更可能選擇儲蓄而非消費，進一步削弱內需。若能源價格持續處於高檔、央行被迫繼續升息，全球經濟目前仰賴AI投資與企業獲利維持的成長韌性，可能迎來真正考驗。
paras_en: The Middle‑East conflict is pushing energy prices, global interest rates and sovereign‑bond yields higher together, steering the world economy and financial markets toward a “stagflation” risk of high inflation and low growth. U.S. equities are still hovering near historic highs and the AI investment boom is supporting earnings, but an increasing amount of data shows cracks in the apparent resilience.

Chris Jeffery, macro‑strategy head at Legal & General Investment Management, said the rise in energy and borrowing costs so far is still mainly a “commodity‑and‑rate story” and has not yet turned into a full‑blown equity or credit crisis, though the market may be edging toward a tipping point that could hit corporate stocks and bonds.

Oil prices have bounced back above $100 a barrel, reviving inflation pressure. As Middle‑East attacks intensify and threaten more supply routes, crude futures have climbed 50% since the war began, and derivatives markets show traders do not expect a sharp short‑term pull‑back.

The market’s most concentrated bet is that Brent crude will sit at $100 a barrel by the end of December, while put options betting on a drop to $60 are close behind, highlighting a huge split in energy outlooks. In addition to crude, diesel is near historic highs, aviation fuel has doubled since the February Iran war outbreak, and European natural gas is at its highest level since 2022.
Polymarket trading forecasts indicate investors see only an 18% chance that the Hormuz Strait will be reopened for traffic before December, suggesting energy‑supply risks could become long‑term.

Higher energy costs are already showing up in consumer prices. U.S. headline inflation held at 3.4% in August, with gasoline up 3.9%; Euro‑area inflation rose from 2.9% in July to 3.3% in August, well above the ECB’s 2% target; and U.K. inflation hit a five‑month high of 3.1% in August.

The ECB has lifted its average inflation forecast for next year to 2.5% and sees core inflation at 2.6% in 2027. Swap‑market pricing is even more pessimistic, implying Euro‑area inflation could reach 3.5% next year and stay around 2.4% in five years’ time.

Rate‑cut expectations have fully reversed as central banks return to tightening. The Middle‑East war has fundamentally altered the global rate outlook. Traders now bet the ECB will raise rates by almost four basis points over the next year, and after the Fed’s one‑point hike on Wednesday, at least two more hikes are expected.

Although the Bank of England kept its policy rate unchanged at 3.75% on Thursday, it projects U.K. inflation could break 4% in early 2027 – double its target and far above the previously forecast 3.2% peak at the end of 2026. The Bank of Japan is expected on Friday to raise rates to the highest level in 31 years, with markets already pricing in further hikes.

Selling pressure in sovereign‑bond markets is pushing borrowing costs higher across the board. The average rate on a 30‑year U.S. mortgage has topped 6.7%, the highest since June 2025. Because government‑bond yields are the benchmark for corporate loans, mortgages and other financing, bond‑market volatility is gradually feeding through to the real economy.

U.S. and European purchasing‑manager indices still show solid private‑sector expansion, and U.K. July growth and U.S. August retail sales both beat expectations. According to LSEG I/B/E/S data, S&P 500 constituents are expected to raise Q2 earnings by 53% year‑over‑year, underpinning the market’s high‑level performance.

Household spending is under pressure and consumer‑discretionary stocks are sounding the first alarm. The real test for the market is whether the economy can bear both high energy prices and high borrowing costs, especially as investors begin to question the sustainability of the multi‑billion‑dollar AI spending spree.

Consumers are on the front line of the storm. Gasoline prices are soaring, and household energy bills could climb further in winter. Europe’s gas inventories have fallen to the lowest level for the same period in 15 years, and with mortgage and other loan rates rising and wages lagging behind prices, disposable income is being squeezed further.

Discretionary‑consumer stocks have already reflected the slowdown risk. U.S. non‑essential consumer stocks are down nearly 6% year‑to‑date, making them Wall Street’s worst‑performing sector, while the S&P 500 as a whole is still up about 10% over the same period. In Europe the picture is even clearer: non‑essential consumer stocks have plunged 17% this year, outperforming only luxury‑goods stocks and lagging far behind the 7.5% gain in the DAX‑Europe 600 index.

As rates and living costs rise together, financially strained households are more likely to save rather than spend, further weakening domestic demand. If energy prices stay high and central banks are forced to keep tightening, the global economy – currently leaning on AI investment and corporate earnings for growth resilience – could face a genuine test.

items.title: 美國上周初領失業金人數意外降至19.6萬 續領人數創逾兩年低點
items.title_en: U.S. Initial Unemployment Claims Unexpectedly Fell to 196,000 Last Week, Continuing Claims Hit Over Two-Year Low
paras: 美國上周初領失業救濟金人數意外降至19.6萬人，創7月以來最低，未經季節調整的數據更降至1969年以來低點，顯示企業裁員意願仍低，勞動市場在夏季一度動盪後逐漸恢復穩定。
美國勞工部(DOL)周四(17日)公布，截至9月12日當周，初領失業救濟金人數減少1萬人至19.6萬人，遠低於《路透》調查經濟學家預估的20.8萬人。用於平滑短期波動的四周移動平均值降至20.325萬人，創五周最低。
不過，數據統計期間涵蓋勞動節假期，而移動日期的假期通常難以進行季節性調整，因此本次降幅可能誇大勞動市場的實際強勁程度。初領人數未經季節調整後大幅下降，主要受到加州、德州、密西根州及紐約州申請人數減少影響。
截至9月5日當周，持續申領失業救濟金人數減少3.9萬人至173萬人，降至2024年1月以來最低。持續申領人數常被視為招聘狀況的參考指標，其下降反映失業者領取補助的時間縮短，但美國企業目前仍普遍不願大舉增加人力。
整體而言，美國勞動市場正呈現「低招聘、低裁員」格局。企業面對美國與以色列對伊朗戰爭、油價上漲及通膨升溫等不確定性，對擴大招聘保持謹慎；求職者也因就業機會不均而不願輕易離職。這使在職者面臨的失業風險處於多年低點，但求職者找到新工作的難度仍偏高。
這份數據涵蓋政府調查9月非農就業人數的參考期間。美國8月非農就業增加16.2萬人，較先前連續三個月的疲弱表現有所改善。
聯準會(Fed)周三升息1碼，將聯邦資金利率目標區間提高至3.75%至4%，主席華許(Kevin Warsh)並將勞動市場列為美國經濟的基本強項之一，認為目前失業率大致符合充分就業。不過，彭博經濟研究指出，申領數據雖顯示裁員壓力有限，Fed進一步緊縮仍可能削弱目前相對穩定的就業市場。
paras_en: U.S. initial unemployment insurance claims unexpectedly dropped to 196,000 last week, the lowest since July and, on an unadjusted basis, the lowest since 1969, indicating that firms’ willingness to lay off workers remains low and the labor market is gradually stabilizing after a summer of turbulence.

The U.S. Department of Labor (DOL) announced on Thursday the 17th that for the week ending September 12, initial claims fell by 10,000 to 196,000, far below the Reuters poll of economists that had forecast 208,000. The four‑week moving average used to smooth short‑term fluctuations fell to 203,250, a five‑week low.

However, the reporting period includes the Labor Day holiday, and moving‑date holidays are difficult to seasonally adjust, so the decline may overstate the labor market’s actual strength. The sharp drop in unadjusted initial claims was driven mainly by fewer applicants in California, Texas, Michigan and New York.

For the week ending September 5, continuing unemployment benefit recipients fell by 39,000 to 1.73 million, the lowest level since January 2024. Continuing claims are often viewed as a gauge of hiring conditions; their decline reflects shorter benefit durations for the unemployed, but U.S. firms still generally hesitate to add large numbers of workers.

Overall, the U.S. labor market is showing a “low hiring, low firing” pattern. Companies, facing uncertainties such as the U.S.–Israel conflict over Iran, rising oil prices and hotter inflation, are cautious about expanding payrolls; job seekers, facing uneven employment opportunities, are reluctant to quit. This keeps the risk of job loss for the employed at a multi‑year low, while finding a new job remains relatively difficult for job seekers.

The data cover the reference period for the government’s September non‑farm payroll survey. Non‑farm employment rose by 162,000 in August, an improvement over the weak performance of the previous three months.

The Federal Reserve raised its policy rate by one basis point on Wednesday, moving the target range for the federal funds rate to 3.75%‑4%. Chair Kevin Warsh cited the labor market as one of the economy’s fundamental strengths and said the current unemployment rate is broadly consistent with full employment. Nonetheless, Bloomberg Economic Research warned that, while the claims data suggest limited layoff pressure, further Fed tightening could still weaken the relatively stable employment situation.

items.title: 習近平訪美前夕 王毅同美國國務卿通話
items.title_en: On the Eve of Xi Jinping's US Visit, Wang Yi Holds Call with US Secretary of State
paras: 在中國國家主席習近平訪美前夕，中共中央政治局委員、中國外交部長王毅17日（周四）同美國國務卿魯比歐通話，雙方深入討論兩國高層交往。
王毅表示，一段時間來，中美關係總體沿著兩國元首確定的建設性戰略穩定軌道前行，這有利於回應國際社會期待。
據《央視》報導，王毅強調，元首外交是中美關係定盤星。雙方要本著平等、尊重、互惠精神籌備好下階段高層交往，加強溝通、推進合作、管控分歧，尊重彼此核心利益，發出中美致力於推進建設性戰略穩定關係、共促世界和平與發展的正面信號。
這場峰會正值美中關係與人工智慧（AI）產業都處於敏感時刻。美中雙方在 AI 競賽、國際貿易、中東局勢等議題上的地緣政治緊張升溫。
美國總統川普預定下周在白宮為習近平舉行國宴，蘋果(AAPL-US) 執行董事長庫克和OpenAI執行長奧特曼都準備出席。
據《彭博》報導，消息人士透露，這兩位科技業高層預計將與其他企業領袖一同出席國宴，包括輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳。
paras_en: On the eve of Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit to the United States, Wang Yi, a member of the CPC Politburo and China's foreign minister, spoke on Thursday the 17th with the US Secretary of State, and the two sides had an in‑depth discussion of high‑level exchanges between the two countries.

Wang Yi said that for some time now, China‑US relations have overall been moving along the constructive and stable strategic track set by the two heads of state, which is conducive to meeting the expectations of the international community.

According to CCTV, Wang Yi stressed that leader‑level diplomacy is the lodestar of China‑US relations. Both sides should, based on equality, respect and mutual benefit, prepare for the next round of high‑level exchanges, strengthen communication, advance cooperation, manage differences, respect each other's core interests, and send a positive signal that China and the US are committed to advancing a constructive, strategically stable relationship and jointly promoting world peace and development.

The summit comes at a sensitive moment for both US‑China relations and the artificial intelligence (AI) industry. Geopolitical tensions are heating up between the two sides on issues such as the AI race, international trade and the Middle East situation.

US President Donald Trump is scheduled to host a state dinner for Xi Jinping at the White House next week, and Apple (AAPL-US) Executive Chairman Tim Cook and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman are both set to attend.
According to Bloomberg, sources said the two tech executives are expected to attend the dinner together with other corporate leaders, including Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang.

items.title: AI資料中心不只缺GPU！格芯、邁威爾聯手擴產光通訊晶片 股價雙雙大漲
items.title_en: AI Data Centers Need More Than GPUs! GlobalFoundries and Marvell Team Up to Expand Optical Communication Chip Production, Shares Surge
paras: 晶圓代工業者格芯(格羅方德/GlobalFoundries)(GFS-US)與晶片設計公司邁威爾科技(Marvell Technology)(MRVL-US)周四(17日)宣布擴大合作，將提高人工智慧(AI)資料中心高速光學連接所需晶片的產能。消息帶動格芯股價盤中上漲逾5%，邁威爾則勁揚6.5%。
根據雙方簽署的多年期協議，格芯將擴充美國佛蒙特州伯靈頓廠的矽鍺(SiGe)製程產能。矽鍺技術能提升半導體元件的運作速度與能源效率，廣泛應用於高速光學網路。
隨著生成式AI模型規模擴大，資料中心需要在伺服器及運算叢集之間快速傳輸龐大資料，帶動高速光學連接需求攀升。相較傳統電訊號，光學傳輸能以較低耗能支援更高頻寬，因此成為AI基礎設施的重要環節。
邁威爾晶圓代工技術副總裁強生(Robb Johnson)表示，擴大與格芯合作，有助確保公司取得足夠的矽鍺技術及製造產能，以支援未來預期的顯著成長。
新增產能將協助邁威爾滿足先進光學網路產品需求，包括可插拔式光收發模組、近封裝光學及共同封裝光學。這些技術可縮短資料傳輸距離、提高傳輸效率並降低耗電，對建置大型AI資料中心日益重要。
此次合作也反映AI晶片需求正從繪圖處理器(GPU)擴散至資料中心網路與光通訊領域。AI運算規模快速擴張，不僅需要更強大的運算晶片，也帶動高速交換器、光學元件及相關半導體製程需求同步成長。
paras_en: Wafer foundry GlobalFoundries (GFS-US) and chip designer Marvell Technology (MRVL-US) announced on Thursday (the 17th) that they are expanding their partnership to increase capacity for chips needed for high‑speed optical connections in AI data centers. The news lifted GlobalFoundries shares more than 5% intraday and Marvell up 6.5%.

Under a multi‑year agreement, GlobalFoundries will expand SiGe (silicon‑germanium) process capacity at its Burlington, Vermont plant. SiGe technology boosts the speed and energy efficiency of semiconductor components and is widely used in high‑speed optical networking.

As generative‑AI models grow larger, data centers must move massive amounts of data quickly between servers and compute clusters, driving up demand for high‑speed optical links. Compared with traditional electrical signals, optical transmission can support higher bandwidth with lower power consumption, making it a key part of AI infrastructure.

Robb Johnson, Marvell’s Vice President of Wafer Foundry Technology, said that expanding cooperation with GlobalFoundries helps ensure the company secures enough SiGe technology and manufacturing capacity to support the expected significant growth ahead.

The added capacity will help Marvell meet demand for advanced optical networking products, including pluggable optical transceiver modules, near‑package optics and co‑packaged optics. These technologies shorten data‑transfer distances, improve transmission efficiency and reduce power draw, which is increasingly important for building large AI data centers.

The partnership also reflects that AI chip demand is spreading beyond graphics processors (GPUs) into data‑center networking and optical‑communication domains. Rapid expansion of AI compute not only calls for more powerful compute chips but also drives growth in high‑speed switches, optical components and related semiconductor processes.

items.title: 《CLARITY法案》沒過也要做！SEC放行代幣化股票 美股迎向24小時交易
items.title_en: Even Without the CLARITY Act, the SEC Clears Tokenized Stocks, Paving the Way for 24‑Hour Trading in U.S. Markets
paras: 美國證券交易委員會(SEC)周四(17日)發布「創新豁免」命令，立即為代幣化股票在美國交易開闢監管途徑。符合條件的交易平台與流動性提供者，未來五年可豁免部分適用於那斯達克及紐約證交所等傳統交易所的規定，向美國投資人提供以區塊鏈為基礎的股票及其他證券。
這項措施在《CLARITY法案》未能通過參議院程序性表決兩天後出爐。該法案原本希望為數位資產及代幣化證券建立明確分類與監管規則，如今SEC選擇運用現有法定權限，推動美國資本市場上鏈。
SEC主席艾特金斯(Paul Atkins)表示，國會儘管付出許多努力，仍未能推進《CLARITY法案》，因此SEC將採取重大行動，促進特定代幣化股票在鏈上交易，讓美國資本市場進入數位時代。

保留股息與投票權 發行公司可拒絕代幣化

根據新規，適用豁免的代幣化股票必須賦予持有人與傳統股票相同的權利，包括領取股息及行使投票權。代幣數量與交易規模也將受到限制，以降低交易量不足時出現劇烈價格波動的風險。
除了上市公司直接將自家股票代幣化，未與發行公司合作的第三方平台也可發行代幣，但必須事先通知相關企業，並等待30天才能開始交易。若企業在期限內提出反對，平台就不得推出該公司的代幣化股票。這項否決權可能限制第三方代幣的供應，尤其是擔心加密交易風險的企業。
新規不適用於僅追蹤股價、卻不提供股票所有權及股東權益的「合成代幣」，例如以證券交換契約包裝的產品。這類代幣目前已在美國以外的加密貨幣交易所大量出現。
SEC強調，五年豁免並非正式且永久的監管規則，而是讓市場先行發展、蒐集實際運作資訊，再用於制定更具彈性的長期制度。部分業者仍擔心，若缺乏國會立法保障，未來政府可能撤銷這項豁免。

24小時交易成真 Coinbase、Robinhood蓄勢待發

支持者認為，股票代幣化可打破傳統證交所的交易時間限制，實現全天候交易與近乎即時交割，降低交易對手風險及成本，也讓散戶能以零股方式持有高價股票，甚至透過智慧合約進行自動化交易。
Coinbase(COIN-US)已表態，希望在監管許可後於美國推出代幣化股票；Robinhood(HOOD-US)、Gemini及Kraken等平台則已在海外提供相關服務。Robinhood也計畫讓持有人以1比1比例將股票代幣兌換為實際股票，並加入投票權，以回應企業對股東權益遭削弱的疑慮。
不過，證券業暨金融市場協會(SIFMA)等團體警告，豁免公平交易、價格透明及投資人保護規範，可能導致市場流動性分散。全天候交易在成交量較低的時段，也可能帶來更大波動。
SEC近年持續放寬美國加密資產交易限制，包括提議取消禁止以劣於全國最佳買賣報價成交的「穿價規則」，並規畫豁免部分數位資產發行的證券註冊要求。這次創新豁免則是迄今將區塊鏈交易導入傳統股票市場的重大一步。
paras_en: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on Thursday (the 17th) issued an "innovation exemption" order, immediately creating a regulatory pathway for tokenized stocks to be traded in the United States. Qualified trading platforms and liquidity providers will be exempt from certain rules that apply to traditional exchanges such as Nasdaq and the New York Stock Exchange for the next five years, allowing U.S. investors to access blockchain‑based stocks and other securities.

The measure was released two days after the CLARITY Act failed to pass a procedural vote in the Senate. The bill had aimed to establish clear classification and regulatory rules for digital assets and tokenized securities; now the SEC is using its existing statutory authority to push the U.S. capital market onto the blockchain.

SEC Chair Paul Atkins said that despite Congress’s considerable effort, the CLARITY Act could not move forward, so the SEC will take decisive action to promote the on‑chain trading of certain tokenized stocks and usher the U.S. capital market into the digital age.

Retention of dividends and voting rights – issuing companies may refuse tokenization. Under the new rules, tokenized stocks that qualify for the exemption must grant holders the same rights as traditional shares, including dividend payments and voting rights. The number of tokens and the scale of trading will also be limited to reduce the risk of extreme price swings when trading volume is thin.

In addition to listed companies tokenizing their own shares, third‑party platforms that are not partnered with the issuing company may also issue tokens, but they must notify the relevant company in advance and wait 30 days before trading can begin. If the company objects within that period, the platform may not launch that company’s tokenized stock. This veto right could curb third‑party token supply, especially for firms wary of crypto‑trading risks.

The new rules do not apply to “synthetic tokens” that merely track a stock price without providing ownership or shareholder rights, such as products packaged as security swap contracts. Such tokens are already abundant on crypto exchanges outside the United States.

The SEC stresses that the five‑year exemption is not a formal, permanent regulatory rule but a temporary measure to let the market develop, gather operational data, and later craft a more flexible long‑term framework. Some participants remain concerned that without congressional legislative protection, future administrations could revoke the exemption.

24‑hour trading becomes a reality as Coinbase and Robinhood gear up. Proponents argue that tokenizing stocks can break the trading‑hour limits of traditional exchanges, enabling round‑the‑clock trading and near‑instant settlement, lowering counterparty risk and costs, allowing retail investors to hold high‑priced stocks in fractional units, and even automate trades via smart contracts.

Coinbase (COIN‑US) has said it hopes to launch tokenized stocks in the U.S. once regulatory clearance is obtained; Robinhood (HOOD‑US), Gemini and Kraken already offer related services overseas. Robinhood also plans to let holders exchange tokenized shares for actual shares on a 1‑to‑1 basis and add voting rights, addressing concerns that corporate shareholder rights are being diluted.

However, industry groups such as the Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association (SIFMA) warn that exempting fair‑trade, price‑transparency and investor‑protection rules could fragment market liquidity. All‑day trading during low‑volume periods could also lead to greater volatility.

In recent years the SEC has continued to ease restrictions on U.S. crypto‑asset trading, including proposals to eliminate the “price‑crossing” rule that bans trades executed at prices worse than the national best bid or offer, and plans to exempt certain digital‑asset issuances from securities registration requirements. This innovation exemption marks a major step toward bringing blockchain trading into the traditional stock market.

items.title: 大立光再砸11.72億元購入台中精密機械園區土地廠房
items.title_en: Largan Precision spends NT$1.172 billion to buy land and factory in Taichung Precision Machinery Park
paras: 光學元件廠大立光 (3008-TW)繼在台中工業區購地接連出手後，並在精密機械園區持續購地，大立光今(17)日公布以11.72億元在精密機械園區內取得產業用不動產，賣方爲台灣固而美工業。
大立光自 6 月底至今並不斷加碼購入工業區內工業用地，今天大立光公布購買廠房土地2259.25坪，建物3695.25坪，金額11.72億元，大立光指出，取得土地及建物具體目的是未來擴充產能需求。
大立光2026年以來積極衝刺共同封裝光學的 CPO 新業務，市場認為，大立光此時接連出手獵地，應是為新事業預先暖身。
大立光股價表現上，今天收盤報6020元，較昨日下跌205元或3.29%，成交量2145張。
paras_en: Optical component manufacturer Largan Precision (3008‑TW) continues its land acquisitions after recent purchases in the Taichung Industrial Zone, and now in the Precision Machinery Park. On the 17th, Largan announced it secured industrial‑use real estate within the park for NT$11.72 billion, with the seller being Taiwan Guremei Industrial.

Since the end of June, Largan has been steadily increasing its holdings of industrial land in the zone. Today it disclosed the purchase of a factory site covering 2,259.25 ping of land and 3,695.25 ping of building space for NT$11.72 billion, stating that the acquisition is intended to meet future capacity‑expansion needs.

Since 2026, Largan has been aggressively pursuing the new CPO (co‑packaged optics) business for joint packaging of optics. The market views the recent string of land deals as preparatory moves to warm up for this new venture.
In terms of stock performance, Largan closed today at NT$6,020, down NT$205 or 3.29% from the previous day, with a trading volume of 2,145 lots.

items.title: 騰輝-KY董事會通過承租昆山廠房擴產 承接AI與HDI外溢訂單
items.title_en: Tenghui‑KY Board Approves Leasing Kunshan Factory for Expansion to Handle AI and HDI Overflow Orders
paras: 銅箔基板大廠騰輝電子-KY(6672-TW)今(17)日召開董事會，決議向董事長王有慈承租位於中國江蘇省昆山的閒置廠房，以取得現成場地進行改建擴產，本次董事會同時通過15億元的擴廠預算，預計分三期並視未來成長需要，分別再進行二期、三期的擴增產能投資。
騰輝-KY指出，新投資案，在完善公司產品組合、顯著提升高毛利特殊材料產能，並透過縮短擴產時程，及時消化外溢訂單，為已創歷史新高的營運動能再挹注強勁成長引擎。
騰輝-KY指出，因應人工智慧（AI）及高速運算應用爆發性發展，算力硬體替代更替帶動高階PCB與基板需求擴張，各大銅箔基板（CCL）大廠優先將產能配置於高階AI伺服器，交換機與儲存等相關硬體應用，進而引發市場所有材料供需嚴重短缺、訂單外溢效應全面擴大。為迅速滿足自身強勁的市場成長需求並擴大市占率。

騰輝-KY的2026年1-8月營收已超越2025年全年，公司執行長鍾健人表示，今年營運迎來爆發性成長，2026年8月單月營收甫以8.1億元創下歷史新高，1-8月累計營收年增達43.3億元，年增53.6%。為快速回應市場的急單與外溢需求，公司選擇承租既有廠房並進行改建，相較於新建廠房可大幅縮短擴產時程，展現公司2-3周的快速交期優勢，有效掌握市場先機。本次承租廠房占地約50-55畝，空間規劃完整，未來可容納兩條自動化生產線，目標達成每月50萬張及粘合片240萬米的總產能，將全面支援第三季起預計季增3成以上的高毛利粘合片與高速材料出貨。
此外，騰輝-KY新廠鄰近既有營運據點，有利於資源整合、物流調度及管理效率提升，進一步強化營運韌性。

騰輝-KY在生產佈局與產品升級方面，現有廠房經結構調整，包括鋼構屋頂挑高及地面承重加強後，將優先安裝4台上膠設備，預計可立即增加現有粘合片產能約70%，加速投產進度。新產能配置將直接挹注公司即將於今年第四季量產的高階400V/800V AI伺服器電源材料（包括高功率散熱膜、高耐熱基板混成、高階26層以上高耐熱多層板及載板材料混成壓合板）。同時，隨著M6等級高速材料放量，以及M7、M8、M9等更高階材料持續向國際大廠進行伺服器與光模塊認證送樣，本廠房將成為高階產品量產的重要基地。
騰輝-KY 在 2026 年第二季營收 16.14 億元，毛利率 35.98%，季增 1.96 個百分點，年增 5.89 個百分點，稅後純益 2.34 億元，季增 89.24%，年增 1.64 倍，每股純益 2.96 元。
騰輝-KY2026 年上半年營收 28.59 億元，毛利率 35.13%，年增 3.11 個百分點，上半年 稅後賺 3.57 億元，年增 59.8%，每股純益達 4.75 元。
paras_en: Tenghui Electronics‑KY (6672‑TW), a major copper‑foil substrate manufacturer, held a board meeting today (the 17th) and resolved to lease an idle factory in Kunshan, Jiangsu Province, China from Chairman Wang You‑ci to obtain a ready‑made site for renovation and capacity expansion. The board also approved a NT$15 billion expansion budget, planned in three phases, with potential Phase 2 and Phase 3 capacity investments depending on future growth needs.

Tenghui‑KY said the new investment will enhance the company’s product portfolio, significantly increase high‑margin specialty material capacity, and by shortening the expansion timeline, promptly absorb overflow orders, injecting a strong growth engine into its historically record‑high operating momentum.

Tenghui‑KY noted that the explosive growth of artificial‑intelligence (AI) and high‑speed computing applications is driving a surge in demand for advanced PCBs and substrates as compute‑hardware upgrades replace older equipment. Major copper‑foil substrate (CCL) manufacturers are prioritising capacity for high‑end AI servers, switches and storage hardware, creating severe material shortages and a widespread order‑overflow effect. The company aims to quickly meet its strong market growth demand and expand market share.

Tenghui‑KY’s revenue for January‑August 2026 has already surpassed the full‑year 2025 figure. CEO Zhong Jian‑ren said the company is experiencing explosive growth this year, with August 2026 single‑month revenue reaching a historic high of NT$8.1 billion and cumulative January‑August revenue up NT$43.3 billion year‑over‑year, a 53.6% increase. To swiftly respond to urgent and overflow orders, the company chose to lease an existing plant and remodel it, which shortens the expansion timeline dramatically compared with building a new facility, showcasing a 2‑3‑week rapid delivery advantage and securing market opportunities. The leased site covers about 50‑55 mu, is fully planned, and can accommodate two automated production lines, targeting a total capacity of 500,000 sheets and 2.4 million m of adhesive films per month, fully supporting an expected >30% quarterly increase in high‑margin adhesive film and high‑speed material shipments from Q3 onward.

In addition, the new plant is adjacent to Tenghui‑KY’s existing operational sites, facilitating resource integration, logistics coordination and management efficiency, further strengthening operational resilience.

Regarding production layout and product upgrades, the existing factory will undergo structural adjustments, including raising the steel‑frame roof and strengthening floor load capacity, after which four laminating machines will be installed first, expected to boost current adhesive‑film capacity by about 70% and accelerate commissioning. The new capacity will directly feed the high‑end 400 V/800 V AI server power‑supply materials slated for mass production in Q4 this year (including high‑power thermal‑film, high‑temperature hybrid substrates, advanced 26‑layer‑plus high‑temperature multilayer boards and hybrid laminate carrier boards). At the same time, as M6‑grade high‑speed materials scale up and higher‑grade M7, M8, M9 materials continue to be submitted for server and optical‑module certification to international OEMs, the plant will become a key base for high‑end product mass production.

Tenghui‑KY reported Q2 2026 revenue of NT$1.614 billion, gross margin of 35.98% (up 1.96 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and 5.89 points year‑over‑year), after‑tax net profit of NT$234 million (up 89.24% quarter‑over‑quarter and 1.64‑fold year‑over‑year), and earnings per share of NT$2.96.

For the first half of 2026, Tenghui‑KY posted revenue of NT$2.859 billion, gross margin of 35.13% (up 3.11 percentage points year‑over‑year), after‑tax profit of NT$357 million (up 59.8% year‑over‑year), and earnings per share of NT$4.75.

items.title: 〈房產〉金仲獎揭曉 信義企業集團20人獲獎再奪業界之冠
items.title_en: <Real Estate> Golden Agent Awards Announced: Xinyi Enterprise Group Wins Again with 20 Awardees, Reclaiming Industry Crown
paras: 年度度房仲業盛事的第25屆傑出「金仲獎」楷模頒獎典禮今(17)日登場，信義(9940-TW)企業集團共20人獲獎，再度拿下業界第一，其中3人獲頒象徵第一的「評審團大獎」，鳳山文山店經理吳琪慧更同時囊括最佳形象獎。
本屆金仲獎由不動產仲介經紀商業同業公會全國聯合會舉辦，信義企業集團共20人獲獎再創業界第一，經紀人組與營業員組分別有10位獲得「房仲楷模」；另外「評審團大獎」部分，共有11位同仁入圍、3名獲獎，大獎得主之一的鳳山文山店經理吳琪慧更二度獲獎，再度拿下最佳形象獎，「先義後利」、「以人為本」的企業精神再受肯定。

今年的評審團大獎得主、同時囊括最佳形象獎的信義房屋鳳山文山店經理吳琪慧是雲林子弟，離鄉背井到高雄加入信義房屋轉眼已11年，初到高雄租屋碰過半夜積水自天花板傾瀉而下的孤立無助，讓她懂得替別人撐傘，也更了解客戶對「家」的渴望、在意每一位客戶真正的需求。曾經陪伴看了10年房子的單親爸爸一路找房，協助他分析風險釐清需求，成交後客戶一句「「謝謝妳，讓我終於完成人生大事，心裡輕鬆很多」，讓吳琪慧更肯定房仲的價值是讓人在重要決定裡感到安心。

同樣獲得評審團大獎的信義房屋竹北文興店專案經理范財嘉，過去當過科技公司的業務，轉戰房仲的新人時期曾面臨名片被管理員當面丟掉的窘境，但他沒有退縮，依舊以真誠與熱忱深耕社區，不僅化解對方敵意，更獲取信任主動轉介客戶。秉持「先義後利」的精神，范財嘉始終為客戶多想一步，曾有外國籍客戶因缺乏本國身分在購屋貸款上屢屢碰壁，他主動陪著客戶奔走、反覆與銀行協商，最終找到願意核貸的銀行、順利成交。後續不僅受邀參加新居入厝，更與客戶成為好友並推薦許多客戶。這一路讓范財嘉堅信，房仲工作的價值不只是促成交易，更是透過專業建立信任，成為人與社會連結的重要力量。
另外一位獲得評審團大獎的信義房屋新埔新站店專案經理王煒智，大學就讀工業工程管理，初入行花了10個月才順利轉正，是全區最晚轉正的新人，但這段經歷讓王煒智奠定「成功或許可以很快，但真正長久的成長，來自於跌倒後仍願意繼續前進」的信念，一路突破成為績優專案經理。他不僅樂於與同仁分享經驗，熱心參與社區活動，面對客戶總是細心的觀察客戶性格與需求調整溝通方式，專業與細緻的服務深獲客戶讚賞。
金仲獎每年由各縣市不動產仲介經紀商業同業公會推薦優秀人員進行遴選，今年於大直典華頒發獎項，除了全台各地的房仲楷模外，另外也會從所有入選者中評選出象徵全國第一的「評審團大獎」，並於現場揭曉得獎者，不同組別各選出五位；並且從評審團大獎得獎者中再遴選出最佳形象、最佳人氣與最佳台風等三位得主。

信義房屋20位獲得房仲楷模的夥伴來自北中南各地，分別為中山晴光專案經理陳冠佑、中山南京專案經理張國榮、新埔新站專案經理王煒智、安康安德專員吳勝哲、土城清水專案經理顏究真、平鎮專員張鈞鋐、小檜溪重劃專員韓鎔安、黎明向上專員劉鎮城、永康鹽行執行經理陳萱蓉、鳳山文山經理吳琪慧、三重雙捷專案經理陳茲芃、汐止樟樹主任黃晨媛、古亭專案經理劉宇軒、內壢經理范姜世旻、竹科專案經理邱竹儀、竹北文興專案經理范財嘉、七期河南專案經理周冠泓、永康鹽行專案經理李子揚、文化店經理詹懿以及信義全球專案暨標售部專案經理李祥楡。
信義房屋指出，公司秉持「先義後利」、「以人為本」的企業理念，並且由上而下深植於員工的心中，更體現在他們的日常工作中。未來將致力提供更值得信賴、更貼心且全面的服務，讓每一名消費者都能感受到信義人的真誠與關懷，實現「有信義的地方，就有幸福」的美好願景。
paras_en: The 25th annual Golden Agent Awards ceremony, the premier event of the year for the real‑estate brokerage industry, was held today (the 17th). Xinyi Enterprise Group (9940‑TW) saw 20 of its staff win awards, once again taking the top spot in the industry. Among them, three received the top‑honor “Jury Grand Prize,” and store manager Wu Qihui of the Fengshan Wenshan branch also captured the Best Image Award.

The awards this year were organized by the National Federation of Real‑Estate Brokerage Trade Associations. Xinyi Enterprise Group’s 20 winners set a new industry record, with ten agents and ten sales staff each earning the “Real‑Estate Model” title. For the Jury Grand Prize, 11 colleagues were shortlisted and three were selected; one of the winners was Wu Qihui, manager of the Fengshan Wenshan store, who also won the Best Image Award for a second time, reaffirming the company’s “principle before profit” and “people‑first” spirit.

Wu Qihui, the Fengshan Wenshan store manager who won both the Jury Grand Prize and the Best Image Award, hails from Yunlin. She left her hometown to join Xinyi in Kaohsiung eleven years ago. Her first experience renting in Kaohsiung involved a midnight ceiling leak that left her feeling isolated and helpless, teaching her to “hold an umbrella for others” and deepening her empathy for clients’ yearning for a home. She once helped a single‑father who had been searching for a home for ten years, clarifying his needs and risks; after the deal closed, he said, “Thank you, you finally helped me complete this major life event; I feel much lighter,” reinforcing Wu’s belief in the value of real‑estate agents in providing peace of mind during critical decisions.

Another Jury Grand Prize winner, project manager Fan Caijia of Xinyi’s Zhubei Wenxing store, previously worked in sales for a tech company. When he first entered real‑estate, a building manager threw his business cards away, but he persisted with sincerity and enthusiasm, turning hostility into trust and referrals. Living by the “principle before profit” ethos, Fan always thinks one step ahead for clients. He assisted a foreign client who repeatedly hit loan obstacles due to lack of local status, accompanying the client to negotiate with banks until a lender approved the loan and the deal closed. The client later invited him to a house‑warming and became a friend who referred many others, confirming Fan’s view that the agent’s role is not just to close deals but to build trust and connect people to society.

The third Jury Grand Prize recipient, project manager Wang Weizhi of Xinyi’s Xinpu Xinzhan store, studied industrial engineering management in college. He took ten months to become a regular employee—the longest in the region—but that experience forged his belief that “quick success is possible, but lasting growth comes from persisting after a fall.” He has since risen to top‑performing project manager, sharing knowledge with colleagues, actively participating in community events, and carefully tailoring communication to each client’s personality and needs, earning high praise for his professional and meticulous service.

The Golden Agent Awards are held annually, with nominations submitted by local real‑estate brokerage trade associations. This year’s ceremony took place at the Dazhi Dianhua venue. In addition to the nationwide “Real‑Estate Model” honorees, a “Jury Grand Prize” representing the top of the field is selected from all nominees, with five winners per category announced on‑stage. From the Grand Prize winners, three further awards—Best Image, Most Popular, and Best Stage Presence—are chosen.

The 20 Xinyi agents honored as Real‑Estate Models come from across the north, central and south regions: project manager Chen Guanyou (Zhongshan Qingguang), project manager Zhang Guorong (Zhongshan Nanjing), project manager Wang Weizhi (Xinpu Xinzhan), specialist Wu Shengzhe (Ankang Ander), project manager Yan Jiuzhen (Tucheng Qingshui), specialist Zhang Junhong (Pingzhen), redevelopment specialist Han Rong’an (Xiaohui Creek), specialist Liu Zhencheng (Liming Xiangshang), executive manager Chen Xuanrong (Yongkang Yanhang), manager Wu Qihui (Fengshan Wenshan), project manager Chen Zipeng (Sanchong Shuangjie), director Huang Chenyuan (Xizhi Zhangshu), project manager Liu Yuxuan (Gutting), manager Fan Jiang Shimin (Neili), project manager Qiu Zhuyi (Hsinchu Science Park), project manager Fan Caijia (Zhubei Wenxing), project manager Zhou Guanhong (Qiqi Hexian), project manager Li Ziyang (Yongkang Yanhang), manager Zhan Yi (Cultural Store), and project manager Li Xiangyu (Xinyi Global Project & Auction Department).

Xinyi Real Estate emphasizes its corporate philosophy of “principle before profit” and “people‑first,” which is deeply ingrained from top management down to every employee and reflected in daily work. Going forward, the company aims to provide more trustworthy, caring and comprehensive services so that every consumer experiences the sincerity and concern of Xinyi staff, fulfilling the vision that “where there is Xinyi, there is happiness.”

items.title: 〈房產〉金仲獎至高榮譽 台灣房屋總裁彭培業獲頒「終身奉獻獎」
items.title_en: <Real Estate> Golden Broker Award Highest Honor: Taiwan Housing President Peng Pei-ye Receives Lifetime Contribution Award
paras: 年度度房仲業盛事的第25屆傑出「金仲獎」楷模頒獎典禮今(17)日登場，本屆「終身奉獻獎」首度由房仲品牌領導人獲獎，台灣房屋集團總裁彭培業榮獲此項殊榮，為房仲業寫下至高榮耀的新紀錄。
不動產仲介經紀商業同業公會全國聯合會理事長王瑞祺表示，「終身奉獻獎」為不動產仲介經紀業至高殿堂榮譽，主要在表彰長期深耕產業、功勳卓著、深孚眾望，對產業制度奠基、專業精進、人才培育及永續發展具有重大貢獻與深遠影響之卓越領袖。
彭培業長年秉持誠信、專業、服務之核心信念，奉獻不動產仲介經紀產業，從產業經營、人才培育、社會責任到公益實踐，各面向成就斐然、建樹卓著，深獲產官學界高度肯定，堪為產業推動永續發展的卓越典範。
彭培業總裁深耕房地產業逾40年，秉持「服務以人為本、管理以人為主」的核心理念，突破房仲買屋、賣屋的傳統框架，從打造房仲智慧服務，到因應高齡化社會投入健康地產，不僅開發亞洲健康智慧園區，更榮登國際級的品質，充分實現社會企業責任的理念，這些都是從消費者需求與社會趨勢，尋找出房仲業的新趨勢，讓「家」的意義從一間房子，延伸到居住環境、健康生活與跨世代的幸福。
彭培業將房仲專業擴大至環境、健康與社會議題，重新定義房仲企業可以創造的價值，就是想為員工、消費者、環境與社會多做些什麼。面對氣候暖化全球議題，他率先啟動植樹造林計畫，於全台四大林場栽植養護超過3萬5000棵樹木，許多人會問，賣房子的人，為什麼選擇種森林，彭培業認為，不只是做別人不做的事，而是想做對的事，
彭培業指出，環境永續是企業肩負的社會責任，不能只是少數人的理念，而要成為一家公司、全民的共同信念，從一棵樹開始，讓每一個人都參與其中，才能共創共好。彭培業同時推動健康農場、友善食安，守護員工與家人的健康生活。而6000坪養生宅「亞洲健康智慧園區」，更為台灣樂齡住宅開闢新典範，為房仲業服務重新定位，開創新紀元。
彭培業以「一家人」為經營哲學，視同仁如親，因此公司裡沒有所謂的總裁，而是以「二哥」來稱呼，他將員工、加盟主視為共同成長的家人，重視人才培育、創造工作價值，帶領品牌多次榮獲幸福企業大獎肯定！在他的經營理念下，企業不只是工作的場所，更是彼此信任、共同成長的家。
paras_en: The 25th Annual Outstanding "Golden Broker Award" ceremony, the premier event of the year for the real‑estate brokerage industry, took place today (the 17th). This year’s Lifetime Contribution Award was awarded for the first time to a leader of a brokerage brand, with Peng Pei-ye, President of Taiwan Housing Group, receiving the honor and setting a new record of supreme glory for the industry.

Wang Rui‑chi, Chairman of the National Federation of Real‑Estate Brokerage Associations, said the Lifetime Contribution Award represents the highest honor in the brokerage field, recognizing leaders who have long cultivated the industry, achieved outstanding merit, earned widespread respect, and made major contributions to institutional foundations, professional advancement, talent development and sustainable growth.

Peng Pei‑ye has long upheld the core values of integrity, professionalism and service, dedicating himself to the real‑estate brokerage sector. His achievements span business operations, talent cultivation, social responsibility and public‑welfare initiatives, earning high praise from government, academia and industry and serving as an exemplary model for sustainable industry development.

With more than 40 years in real‑estate, President Peng adheres to the philosophy “service centered on people, management led by people.” He has broken the traditional buying‑and‑selling framework, advancing smart brokerage services and, in response to an aging society, investing in health‑focused real‑estate. He has developed an Asian health‑smart park that meets international quality standards, fully embodying corporate social responsibility. By listening to consumer needs and social trends, he identifies new directions for the brokerage sector, expanding the meaning of “home” from a mere dwelling to a living environment, healthy lifestyle and inter‑generational happiness.

Peng has broadened brokerage expertise to include environmental, health and social issues, redefining the value a brokerage can create for employees, consumers, the environment and society. Confronting global climate change, he launched a tree‑planting program, planting and caring for over 35,000 trees across four major forest farms in Taiwan. When asked why a real‑estate seller would plant forests, Peng answered that it is not just about doing what others don’t, but about doing what is right.

Peng emphasized that environmental sustainability is a corporate social responsibility that must become a shared belief of the whole company and society, not just a minority view. Starting with a single tree and involving everyone is the way to achieve collective benefit. He also promotes healthy farms and food safety, protecting the health of employees and their families. The 6,000‑ping (approximately 19,800 sqm) wellness residence, the “Asian Health‑Smart Park,” sets a new benchmark for senior living in Taiwan, redefining brokerage services and ushering in a new era.

Peng runs the company with a “one‑family” philosophy, treating colleagues as relatives. Consequently, there is no formal title of president within the firm; he is affectionately called “Second Brother.” He regards employees and franchisees as family members growing together, prioritizes talent development and meaningful work, and has led the brand to win multiple Happiness Enterprise Awards. Under his leadership, the company is more than a workplace—it is a trusted home for mutual growth.

items.title: Fed重啟升息台股承壓？野村拆解26年數據：1年回歸基本面 慎防3大修正警訊
items.title_en: Fed Resumes Rate Hikes, Taiwan Stocks Under Pressure? Nomura Breaks Down 26 Years of Data: One-Year Return to Fundamentals, Guard Against Three Major Correction Signals
paras: 聯準會（Fed）於台灣時間今（17）日凌晨宣布升息1碼，主席華許指出美經濟走強且通膨仍高，美股聞聲下挫。對此，野村投信統計2000年以來三次降息循環後首次升息經驗，台股短線易受利率與評價調整干擾，升息後1個月平均下跌3.99%，但1年、2年與3年平均報酬分別達3.57%、19.73%與33.74%，最遲一年即可回歸基本面。本輪貨幣政策與2004年相似，皆在降息結束約1年後升息，且同處科技提升生產力階段，當年由網路驅動，如今則由AI接棒，中長期行情仍值得期待，但需觀察三個指標。
主動野村台灣高息ETF（00999A）基金經理人游景德表示，台股短線受美債殖利率與外資流向牽動，指數恐偏震盪。AI龍頭相對具支撐，高估值中小型股、融資股及高負債公司壓力較大。未來1至6個月，企業獲利將取代本益比擴張，只要AI供應鏈營收、毛利率及獲利預估持續上修，即可消化部分高利率壓力。本次升息源於強勁需求與資本支出，並非經濟衰退，資金將由「有題材」轉向真正具備現金流、訂單與議價能力的企業。
在產業配置上，潛在贏家包括AI基礎建設龍頭、美元營收出口商、現金充裕低負債公司及部分金融股。銀行股受惠利差與海外收益改善，壽險股則須留意長債評價與避險成本。至於可能輸家，包含高估值未獲利中小型科技股、營建與租賃等高負債公司、仰賴融資的新創、生技與再生能源，以及面臨成本壓力的航空、下游石化與低成長高股息族群。
展望後市，游景德提出3大觀察指標：第一，美國10年期公債殖利率5%為評價分水嶺，若升破5.25%，台股估值壓力將明顯加重；第二，布蘭特原油若站穩每桶110美元以上，升息預期恐再升溫；第三，觀察外資與台積電 (2330-TW) 等AI權值股表現，若外資賣超但AI龍頭守穩，偏向結構調整，若兩者同步轉弱，指數修正風險才會升高。投資策略宜降低槓桿、保留彈性，布局具獲利能見度與現金流支撐的企業。
paras_en: The Federal Reserve announced a 0.25‑point rate hike in the early hours of today (Sept 17 Taiwan time). Chair Jerome Powell noted that the U.S. economy remains strong while inflation stays high, prompting a pull‑back in U.S. equities. Nomura Asset Management examined the three post‑2000 rate‑cut cycles and found that the first hike after a tightening cycle tends to weigh on Taiwan’s market in the short term – the index fell an average of 3.99% in the month after a hike – but over one, two and three years the average returns were 3.57%, 19.73% and 33.74% respectively, meaning fundamentals tend to re‑assert themselves within a year. This round of policy is similar to 2004, when hikes began about a year after the end of easing, and both periods coincide with a productivity‑boosting tech era – then driven by the internet, now by AI – so the medium‑ to long‑term outlook remains positive, though three warning indicators should be watched.

Fund manager You Jing‑de of Nomura’s Taiwan High‑Yield ETF (00999A) said Taiwan’s market is currently being tugged by U.S. Treasury yields and foreign‑investor flows, likely leading to a choppy index. AI‑lead stocks have relative support, while high‑valuation small‑caps, leveraged stocks and highly indebted firms face greater pressure. Over the next one to six months, corporate earnings will replace P/E expansion as the key driver; as long as AI‑chain revenue, margins and profit forecasts keep being upgraded, they can absorb part of the high‑rate stress. This hike stems from strong demand and capex, not a recession, so capital will shift from “thematic” bets to companies with real cash flow, order books and pricing power.

In terms of sector allocation, potential winners include AI‑infrastructure leaders, exporters with dollar‑denominated revenue, cash‑rich low‑debt firms and some financial stocks. Banks should benefit from wider spreads and better overseas earnings, while life‑insurance stocks need to watch long‑bond valuations and hedging costs. Likely losers are over‑valued, unprofitable small‑cap tech names, high‑debt construction and leasing firms, financing‑dependent startups, biotech and renewable‑energy companies, as well as airlines, downstream petrochemicals and low‑growth high‑dividend groups that face cost pressures.

Looking ahead, You Jing‑de highlighted three observation points: first, the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield at 5% is a valuation threshold – a rise above 5.25% would noticeably increase valuation pressure on Taiwan stocks; second, Brent crude holding above US$110 per barrel could reignite rate‑hike expectations; third, watch foreign‑investor activity and the performance of AI‑weight stocks such as TSMC (2330‑TW). If foreigners sell but AI leaders hold steady, it suggests a structural adjustment; if both weaken together, the risk of an index correction rises. Investment strategy should reduce leverage, retain flexibility, and focus on companies with clear profit visibility and solid cash‑flow support.

items.title: 新增5檔股票明起抓去關  飆股全友、聯一光處置期至9/30
items.title_en: Five Stocks Added to Trading Halt Starting Tomorrow; Hot Stocks Quanyou and Lianyi Guang to Remain Restricted Until Sept. 30

近年從掃描器大廠轉型，並積極拓展光電子設備的全友處置原因：最近6個營業日累積收盤價漲幅達45.96%；最近30個營業日起迄2個營業日之收盤價漲幅達104.9%；最近90個營業日起迄2個營業日之收盤價漲幅達223.21%。

paras_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange and the OTC market announced today (the 17th) that five securities are being added to the restriction list: listed stock Quanyou (2305‑TW) and over‑the‑counter stocks Lianyi Guang (3441‑TW), Taiwan Precision Materials (3467‑TW), Juyou Technology (8227‑TW) and Jinju (8358‑TW). The hot stocks Quanyou and Lianyi Guang will be subject to disposal from tomorrow (the 18th) through September 30, covering seven trading days, while the other three will be cleared on September 24. All five will trade on a 2‑minute matching cycle.

Quanyou, which has shifted from a major scanner manufacturer to expanding its optoelectronic equipment business, is being restricted because its closing price has risen 45.96% over the past six trading days, 104.9% over the past 30 trading days up to two days ago, and 223.21% over the past 90 trading days up to two days ago.

Lianyi Guang’s restriction is due to a 30.66% increase in its last‑trade price over the past six trading days (including today), a 128.08% rise in its last‑trade price over the past 30 trading days up to two days ago, a 395.76% rise over the past 90 trading days up to two days ago, and a turnover rate of 118.98% on the day.

Further details on Lianyi Guang’s restriction: Yuanta Securities accounted for 32.17% of the day’s total volume in its sales of the security; the day’s price‑earnings ratio was 79.22 and the price‑to‑book ratio 9.3, which is 4.02 times the industry average; Yuanta bought NT$2.434 billion worth of the security, representing 26.3% of the day’s total transaction value, and sold NT$2.986 billion, representing 32.26% of the day’s total transaction value.

Taiwan Precision Materials is being restricted because its last‑trade price rose 36.62% over the past six trading days, its volume on the day was 14.47 times the average volume of the preceding 60 trading days, and the turnover rate reached 8.97%.

Juyou Technology is being restricted as its last‑trade price increased 27.94% over the past six trading days, with a price gap of NT$40.5 between the last‑trade price on the day and two days later, and a turnover rate of 8.17% on the day.
Jinju’s restriction cites a price‑earnings ratio of 71.31, a price‑to‑book ratio of 12.99—3.48 times the industry average—and a turnover rate of 12.4% on the day.

items.title_en: TIE Opening Brings Good News! Zhongguang Electronics’ Drone Wins Major US Police Contract, Yulong Robotics Targets North American Market
paras: 2026台灣創新技術博覽會「創新經濟館」今(17) 日於台北世貿一館盛大開幕，由經濟部產發署、技術司、中企署、能源署、國營司及智慧局共同策劃。展館集結118家廠商與195項技術，近半數結合AI應用，聚焦無人機、智慧水務、機器人及醫療科技，包括中光電的無人機AI識別技術及宇隆的人形機器人關節模組，分別獲美國軍警及民間業者採用。
經濟部政務次長江文若表示，AI價值在於解決實際問題，經濟部將持續協助業者將研發能量轉化為實際商用，搶攻全球市場機會。

展出亮點中，產發署展出中光電 (5371-TW) 無人機AI識別暨動態定位技術，最快1秒內鎖定追蹤，已完成國防部軍用商規無人機交付，並與美商Teledyne FLIR合作由中光電在台製造，成功投入美國警方實際執勤。技術司則展示工研院3.2T矽光子光引擎，傳輸容量提升至3.2T，已串聯逾20家台日及國外業者，協助廠商打入輝達 (NVDA-US) 供應鏈。此外，宇隆 (2233-TW) 人形機器人關節模組亦獲美國業者採用，能源署零稀土EC風扇馬達則鎖定AI資料中心與半導體廠節能需求。
科技應用同步延伸至公共建設與醫療領域。台灣自來水公司推出智慧水務雙核心，於南投鳥嘴潭及台南曾文淨水場導入無人船與AI數位孿生；中鼎 (9933-TW) 展出大型管道機器人，降低密閉管線檢修風險；醫電鼎眾則發表工業內視鏡，大幅縮短航空引擎與管路檢修時間。在健康醫療方面，工研院中大分子尿毒素量測技術已於成大醫院完成驗證，可即時掌握透析效果。展期將持續至9月19日，全力推動技術媒合與產業落地。
paras_en: The 2026 Taiwan Innovation Technology Expo’s “Innovation Economy Hall” opened today (Sept. 17) at Hall 1 of the Taipei World Trade Center, organized jointly by the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ Industrial Development Administration, Technology Division, SME Administration, Energy Administration, State-owned Enterprise Administration and Smart Bureau. The hall gathers 118 companies showcasing 195 technologies, nearly half of which integrate AI applications, focusing on drones, smart water management, robotics and medical technology. Among them, Zhongguang Electronics’ AI‑enabled drone recognition technology and Yulong’s humanoid robot joint modules were adopted respectively by U.S. military‑police and civilian operators.

Deputy Minister of Economic Affairs Jiang Wen‑ruo said that AI’s value lies in solving real‑world problems, and the ministry will continue to help companies turn R&D capabilities into commercial products to seize global market opportunities.

Key exhibits included Zhongguang Electronics (5371‑TW) displaying its drone AI recognition and dynamic positioning technology, which can lock onto and track targets in as fast as one second. The system has completed delivery of military‑grade drones for the Ministry of National Defense and, in partnership with U.S. firm Teledyne FLIR, is being manufactured in Taiwan and deployed for actual police operations in the United States. The Technology Division showcased ITRI’s 3.2‑terabit silicon‑photonics optical engine, boosting transmission capacity to 3.2 Tb and already linking over 20 Taiwanese, Japanese and foreign companies, helping them enter NVIDIA’s (NVDA‑US) supply chain. Yulong (2233‑TW) also announced that its humanoid robot joint modules have been adopted by U.S. customers, while the Energy Administration highlighted its zero‑rare‑earth EC fan motor aimed at AI data centers and semiconductor factories for energy savings.

Technology applications also extended to public infrastructure and healthcare. Taiwan Water Corporation introduced a dual‑core smart water management system, deploying autonomous surface vessels and AI digital twins at the Niaotou Reservoir in Nantou and the Zengwen Water Treatment Plant in Tainan. China Steel (9933‑TW) exhibited a large‑scale pipeline robot that reduces the risk of confined‑space inspections. MedTech firm Dingzhong presented an industrial endoscope that dramatically shortens inspection times for aircraft engines and pipelines. In the health sector, ITRI’s macromolecular uremic toxin measurement technology was validated at National Cheng‑Kung University Hospital, enabling real‑time monitoring of dialysis efficacy. The exhibition runs through September 19, aiming to maximize technology matchmaking and industry implementation.
